label: <DEL> step of long (L=8-9) sequences starting with c
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.002% of steps). Fires only at the delimiter step (t == L, recall_idx 0), almost always when the first original token is c (98.7% of mass; a few w/y-first cases), and only for long sequences: L=9 holds 91% of mass, L=8 the rest, never L<=7. Recall of the predicate is ~98% but precision is only ~2%: most c-first long sequences do not trigger it. Magnitude is higher when the early tokens include x, v, m, i (top examples: c x i m v ..., c x v m ...); requiring >=3 of {x,v,m,i} raises precision to ~16% but halves recall, so the exact secondary condition is unresolved. Never fires in the original or copy phases.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 31 cues. Raise it: phase=1 & out_tok=c (+5.26), orig3=m (+1.92), t=9 & prev_tok=0 (+1.57), orig2=v (+1.50), orig2=m (+1.44), orig4=m (+1.40). Lower it: orig7=- (-2.63), in_first=0 (-2.53), recall_idx=-1 (-2.23), orig8=- (-2.18).
